name: pey.markdown
description: Render Markdown (CommonMark + GFM) to a sanitized HTML fragment with injectable Persian extensions

provides.name: pey.markdown.service
provides.description: Stateless Markdown to sanitized HTML fragment rendering

methods.name: renderFragment
methods.description: Render Markdown to a sanitized HTML fragment. GFM always on. Persian extensions only when passed per call. Footnote labels standard English unless footnoteOptions are passed; footnote and heading ids scoped by optional idPrefix. Every h1-h6 heading gets a stable plugin-built id (user-content-h-<slug>, non-ASCII percent-encoded) and the returned toc array carries exactly the ids applied in the html.
methods.returns: { html: string, toc: Array<{ id: string, level: number, text: string }> }
